title: MoodProcessed
description: Published by Catalogue when a song's mood is derived from metadata (or supplied at upload). Consumed by Catalogue to persist the mood column; other services may subscribe for discovery flows. Duplicate delivery is idempotent.

song_id.description: The song whose mood was derived.

mood.description: Derived mood label, e.g. energetic, chill, melancholy, romantic, focus, ambient.
